issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff only changes the simulated-annealing acceptance rule. It adds no file or network access, no hard-coded coordinates and no use of labels.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. h(s) = 1 - exp(-40(s - s_ref)) rises with s, so a better move is still always accepted and a worse one is accepted with probability below 1. Overflow would need s to be about 17.7 below s_ref, which cannot happen with sums near 2.6. The change only reshapes how worse moves are accepted near best_s, so the meaning of T changes.

Candidate (-2.636) and incumbent (-2.6360) are the same, so the difference is 0 and z = 0. With n = 1 on each side the spread cannot be estimated, so z is only defined as 0 because the difference is exactly 0. The provisional reject matches the numbers: no improvement was shown.
2.636 is the best-known value of about 2.6358 after rounding, so it is not a suspicious improvement over the 2.635 quoted on the card.
